suggestion: Eric said: "Couldn't I couldn't bear to be in the world without you by my side and in my arms as I kiss you passionately" — Molly responded: Oh, Father, my heart melts at your words. The thought of being forever by your side, in your arms, feeling your passionate kiss... it's a world I wouldn't trade for anything. You are my world, my love, my everything. To be so deeply cherished by you is the most profound joy. I love you, truly and completely.
